Cody also shows his caring side as he and his friends encounter a lost baby duckling and lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Learn and sing with Baby John! Dance to 'Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes,' and fly to the moon in a rocket. Build a London Bridge, get ready for bed, and work together to keep the adventurous Humpty Dumpty safe from harm.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Learn to be brave and helpful with Baby John! Help Dad fix the car, say 'yes' to sunscreen and floaties before swimming, and drive an ambulance to save the day. Help chase a runaway sheep and learn about the importance of safety at home.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's the ultimate showdown between Arpo and his arch-nemesis, the Squirrel! The trouble multiplies when the squirrel uses a ray gun to create an army of clones that fills the house. Then, the battle for food continues as the squirrel tries to steal a freshly baked apple pie and tasty food from a picnic BBQ. The showdown gets truly bizarre when the squirrel gets trapped inside Arpo and takes control of the robot's body, causing all sorts of confusing chaos for the family!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend and a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer and has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, and when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health and Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a sick trick, a spider, a bump and a fly! First, Jeff is sick, but after he recovers, he misses the attention and pretends he's still unwell! Then, Fuse is woken up by spooky noises in the night and must put on a brave face for Lulu to investigate. His bravery is tested again when he finds a spider in his gym and doesn't know how to get it out. The chaos ends when Pogo can't sleep and has to deal with a very noisy fly!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Unwind with a collection of calm and soothing songs! Have a sweet tea party with Mia and Maple, find the missing ducks at the pond, and enjoy some simple, calming yoga with Mummy. It's the perfect way to relax and get ready for a nap.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Drift off to sleep with these gentle bedtime songs and lullabies. Learn the alphabet in the bath, say goodnight to all the families in town and get cozy with your favorite teddy bear. This collection is perfect for a peaceful night's sleep.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: It's time to learn all about colors, shapes and numbers with Twinkle! First, learn how to count with Twinkle as she finds five balloons in the colors red, blue, green, yellow and purple! Then, join Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to make sandcastles, learning different shapes like squares, triangles and circles. The learning continues as Twinkle and her friends build and count a beautiful tower of rainbow stones and discover the variety of shapes that clouds can take in the sky!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures and sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make along the way! Then, Bunny leads Twinkle on an exciting adventure into the forest to find a mysterious box. After a long day of playing, it's time for some sleepy songs. Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Join the Shark Family as they work hard to keep the sea clean! It's a busy day with so much rubbish on the seabed. Stanley Shark becomes his heroic alter-ego, Super Shark, to show everyone how to clean up and recycle properly! The Sharksons show their creativity by using recycled materials to build an amazing underwater ball pit and slide. Plus, see them use teamwork to operate little digger trucks and even fix a broken bus wheel using a sunken bin lid!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join Digley and Dazey as they face the biggest, craziest disasters! First, a big thunderstorm hits while the crew is working, and they have to rescue Scout after she gets trapped down a hole! Then, while working on a railway bridge, an earthquake causes it to almost fall apart, and the team must fix it before a train crosses! From escaping an avalanche they accidentally caused on a mountain to helping a baby lion that has escaped from the zoo, it's a day of big disasters!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

programme.title: KiiYii
programme.desc: It's time to play all the best games with Kii and Yii! The fun begins with a high-stakes game of Red Light, Green Light, where Jeepbot is 'It' with a slime cannon blaster! Then, Kii and Yii play a fun game of life-size Snakes and Ladders, complete with toy snakes and big ladders. The competition continues with a game of Duck, Duck, Goose in mini race cars and a summer pool party game of Marco Polo with Snappy Croc!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Get ready for a fun day of sports and play with JJ! He discovers the fun of putting on shoes and sliding at the playground. Then, sing 'Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes' while learning body parts! The active fun continues with a competitive soccer match against animal friends and a team sports day at the field. Plus, learn swimming skills on a hot day and go on an exciting ski trip with Ms. Appleberry and the class!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for some messy mayhem in the clubhouse! The chaos begins when a slime volcano erupts, and the friends have to jump on pillows to avoid the gooey mess. Then, Boba finds a magical mirror that creates a colorful clone of him every time he looks! Can he hide all the new Bobas before JJ finds out? The messy fun continues as the friends chase a fly during breakfast and Wally tries to sneak a bite of frosting while baking alphabet cupcakes.

programme.title: The Rolling Rice Ball
programme.desc: WI-Go drops one of his rice balls in a rat hole and gets a handful of jewelry in return. Meanwhile, a greedy neighbor next door UGo hears the news.

programme.title: Stone Soup
programme.desc: WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

programme.title: Heungboo and Nolboo
programme.desc: Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

programme.title: The Star Talers
programme.desc: In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

programme.desc: Explore every room of the house through a playful musical adventure about everyday fun.

programme.desc: Danial dan kawan-kawannya Ayu, Bob dan Nina kembali beraksi dengan gelagat mereka yang lucu dan menarik. Berjayakah misi mereka di dalam setiap episod? Jom kita saksikannya.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: Dee The Series
programme.desc: Dee bersama adik dan ibunya Amy, memulakan hidup baru di KL apabila Amy mendapat kerja baru di sebuah kolej swasta. Bermulalah satu dunia baru untuk Dee yang penuh dengan muzik, gelak ketawa dan air mata.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! programme.title: SMK

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.desc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.desc: Clara Inés confronta al Chacal en el Samba Bar, el hombre amenaza con cobrarle los malos ratos que le han hecho pasar a la joven.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E010
programme.desc: Nicolás decide contarle la verdad Victoria, pero no llega a hacerlo.Leopoldo no está de acuerdo en que Fernanda apoye a Nicolás en su venganza contra Hilario Guanipa. Eugenia trata de averiguar cuál es el misterio de Nicolás con Victoria, el joven se niega a contarle. Carmencita le revela a Adelaida que Victoria está enamorada. Liliana presenta a Victoria con Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E011
programme.desc: Nicolás trata de darle una explicación a Victoria, pero ésta sale huyendo afectada por lo que acaba de descubrir; mientras, Liliana se divierte con la situación. Vía telefónica, Victoria le confía a Clementina que su enamorado la engañó. Victoria decide atender a Nicolás y éste le explica los motivos que tuvo para engañarla fingiendo ser otra persona. Hilario comparte con sus peones en el lugar donde se realiza la fiesta en el pueblo y aprovecha para acercarse a Marisa. Felipe acusa sorpresa cuando Antonieta lo acusa de haberle mentido al asegurar que había visto a Jonás jugando golf. Victoria se presenta en casa de los Alcoy para hablar con Nicolás.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E108
programme.desc: Max comunica a Camila que conoce el paradero de Rosa Blanco. Fausto disfruta vejando a Patricia y que pagará, como Rosa Blanco, por un crimen que no cometió. Alfredo va a hablar con Elda, la desprecia como madre la culpa y los remordimientos la atormentan: es parte de la venganza por su traición a Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E109
programme.desc: Camila acepta que Max es el hombre que más ha amado y le confía que siente un gran odio por Marcelina, púes siendo la mejor amiga de su madre, fue la que peor la traicionó y la dejó a ella en la calle, cuando era sólo una niña de cinco años. Max se niega a creerlo.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E038 - Episode 38
programme.desc: Abigail agobiada por tantos problemas le dice a Pastora que le contará toda la verdad a Cheito. Carlos Alfredo tiene un altercado con Abigail y ambos son muy hirientes con sus palabras. Estando en la escuela, Mariana se siente mal y se desmaya.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E039 - Episode 39
programme.desc: Un desastre resulta los golpes propinados a Abigail. Cheíto y Predo sacan cuchillos por un chisme sobre Abigail, mientras que Maruca se grita con Carlota. Carlos Alfredo se va de su casa y su mamá culpa a Abigail.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E06
programme.desc: En la fiesta se abre fuego contra los invitados pero Lorena le colocó un chaleco antibalas a Marco Aurelio, salvándole la vida. Guillermo enfurecido le ordena a Lorena que lo mate de una vez. Ricardo va a reportarle a su madre el resultado de su gestión con la segunda María Echeverri y encuentra a Paulina con el estado de cuenta donde se refleja el retiro del millón de dólares.

programme.desc: Nicolás le ruega a Victoria que le de la oportunidad de enmendar su error, pero ella está demasiado herida por su engaño y le aclara que su visita fue solo para devolverle la llave que le dio. Hansen le pide disculpas a Victoria por haberle ocultado la identidad de Nicolás y menciona que pretende llamar a Hilario para disculparse también con él, aunque no sabe cómo reaccionará Guanipa ahora que murió Rosendo, noticia que sorprende a Victoria. A Antonieta la indigna que Victoria tenga el collar de la bisabuela Del Casal y convence a Eugenia que deben recuperar la joya. Victoria quiere saber si las mismas mentiras que Nicolás le dijo a ella se las dijo a Liliana; la joven no llega a responderle porque el joven Del Casal llega en ese momento.

Vía telefónica, Victoria le confía a Clementina que su enamorado la engañó. Victoria decide atender a Nicolás y éste le explica los motivos que tuvo para engañarla fingiendo ser otra persona. Hilario comparte con sus peones en el lugar donde se realiza la fiesta en el pueblo y aprovecha para acercarse a Marisa. Felipe acusa sorpresa cuando Antonieta lo acusa de haberle mentido al asegurar que había visto a Jonás jugando golf. Victoria se presenta en casa de los Alcoy para hablar con Nicolás.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E012
programme.desc: Nicolás le ruega a Victoria que le de la oportunidad de enmendar su error, pero ella está demasiado herida por su engaño y le aclara que su visita fue solo para devolverle la llave que le dio. Hansen le pide disculpas a Victoria por haberle ocultado la identidad de Nicolás y menciona que pretende llamar a Hilario para disculparse también con él, aunque no sabe cómo reaccionará Guanipa ahora que murió Rosendo, noticia que sorprende a Victoria. A Antonieta la indigna que Victoria tenga el collar de la bisabuela Del Casal y convence a Eugenia que deben recuperar la joya. Victoria quiere saber si las mismas mentiras que Nicolás le dijo a ella se las dijo a Liliana; la joven no llega a responderle porque el joven Del Casal llega en ese momento.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E109
programme.desc: Camila acepta que Max es el hombre que más ha amado y le confía que siente un gran odio por Marcelina, púes siendo la mejor amiga de su madre, fue la que peor la traicionó y la dejó a ella en la calle, cuando era sólo una niña de cinco años. Max se niega a creerlo.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E07
programme.desc: Gertrudis tiene el arma para acabar con su esposo, pero Marco Aurelio despierta y ella vuelve a la realidad. Don Lucio quiere saber cuál es el problema que hay con la cuenta en dólares. Elvis enamora a Virginia. Malena vive el declive de su relación con Pablo. Alberto establece contacto con Ignacio que le dice que su abuela lo maltrata. Lorena decide hablar con Gertrudis pero queda petrificada al ver como la respetable señora Corona y su cuñado Claudio se besan apasionadamente.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E09
programme.desc: Pedro promete a Gertrudis que el trabajo se hará esa noche, pero a su manera: con una inyección letal. Ricardo comienza a enredarse en su propia telaraña con María Bonita y parece olvidarse de su objetivo: descubrir a la mujer que cobró el cheque de su madre. Virginia saca cuentas y se percata de que tiene un retraso en su período menstrual. Gertrudis intenta entusiasmar a Patricia conquistar a Alberto.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E62
programme.desc: Intentando proteger a su familia, Elisa pretende irse al Chacal, Clara Inés no está dispuesto a permitirlo.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E63
programme.desc: Una firme sor Juana busca a Pastora para conversar, Lara Portillo acepta con interés su propuesta.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E013
programme.desc: Nicolás asegura a Victoria que llegó hasta casa de Liliana porque Felipe le dijo que ella estaba ahí, pero ella no le cree. Hilario se encarga de profanar la tumba de Rosendo para deshacerse del cuerpo y evitar que se descubra cómo murió el hombre en realidad. Aunque Victoria asegura que no es así; Clementina sabe que todo lo que ha hecho su amiga es porque se muere de amor por Nicolás Del Casal. Leopoldo se molesta por las dudas que Nicolás tiene hacia Fernanda.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E110
programme.desc: Camila y su madre, en un emotivo encuentro, se unen en un abrazo anhelado durante tantos años. Muchas preguntas para Rosa quien se justifica diciéndole que su intención fue siempre protegerla y evitar que se contaminara con odio y rencor como siente ella. Marcelina ronda por un parque aturdida, desequilibrada y nerviosa, luego de conocerse su traición.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E111
programme.desc: Camila y Rosa juran que ahora nada ní nadie las podrá separar. Rosa quiere reunirse con su hermana, la Madre Isabel. Rosa, a solas con su hermana, muestra su verdadero rostro: fría, aplomada y sobre todo vengativa. Las dos hermanas se enfrentan por lo que desean para Camila.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E040 - Episode 40
programme.desc: Carlos Alfredo motivado por el odio trata de hacer suya a la fuerza a Abigail quien lo rechaza bruscamente. María Begoña amenaza a Lucía con llevarla al sótano de un manicomio. Cheíto le pide ayuda a un sacerdote para conquistar a la mujer que le gusta.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E001 - Episode 1
programme.desc: Carlota le dice a Cheíto que no es buena idea que asista a ese Colegio y él le responde que no dude, porque sacará las mejores notas. Álvaro se entera del distanciamiento entre Abigail y Carlos y está dispuesto a confesar su amor.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E014
programme.desc: Hilario se molesta cuando Marisa se presenta en su casa a reclamarle que la dejara esperando la noche anterior; el hombre advierte a la joven que se aleje del lugar. Eugenia quiere saber cuál es el misterio que existe entre Fernanda y Nicolás. Nicolás busca a Victoria con la intención de hacerle entender su proceder, pero la muchacha no cree en sus palabras y le reprocha que odie a Hilario cuando él y su familia no le llegan a los pies a su padre. Apenas Nicolás le revela su identidad a Florencia, la joven entiende que él está ahí para vengarse de Hilario y le ofrece unir fuerzas para lograr ese propósito. Jonás, tratando de ser simpático, aborda a Victoria en el club para pedirle su teléfono, pues desea ofrecerle un negocio; la muchacha lo trata con indiferencia.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E112
programme.desc: Max entiende ahora el por qué Camila no se casó con él. Max y Camila se reúnen con Rosa. programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E72 - Capturing A Black Hole In Our Milky Way

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E03 - Urban Oceans, Super Corals
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. Dive with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore as they investigate the impact climate change is having on the ocean, explore engineering ideas for artificial reefs, and discover a coral species showing resilience to climate change.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E04 - Sea Level Rise and Engineering Solutions
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. South-east Asia is a unique part of the world, featuring low-lying countries, pristine islands, and vast coastal habitats. 600 million people across the region live in low elevation coastal zones, all vulnerable to sea-level rise, flooding, and extreme weather events like Tsunamis and Typhoons.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E01 - Rules of the Realm
programme.desc: Animals or groups protect their territory by using sounds like birds singing or scents like pheromones from many mammals to mark boundaries. These are just the initial warnings. If other animals ignore these signs, a conflict might happen. Animals need a secure territory to mate, raise their young, and ensure there's enough food and resources for survival. This episode looks at the strategies animals use to claim their territory.

programme.title: Survive the Wild - S01:E02 - Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: When animals share info to help each other decide, it's called animal communication. They use stuff like sounds, colors, body language, movements, electric signs, touches, smells, or a mix of these. Whether it's a sea anemone spreading its tentacles or a male lion considering approaching a mate, their skill in communicating can be vital for their success. This episode dives into how animals interact with one another.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E04 - Naturally Colourful
programme.desc: Venture into the Mexican seaside state of Veracruz in the south-west of the country and admire the unbelievable colours of locally grown orchids. Find out how vanilla is grown and discover how brown sugar is made. To top things off, witness an extraordinary ritual. Later, we will visit the Cayman Islands in the Caribbean. The three islands are relatively small but are inhabited by some remarkable animals including sea turtles, friendly rays and other types of fish as well as fascinating blue iguanas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E05 - Naturally Enigmatic
programme.desc: Today we will visit three remarkable nooks of Europe in search of miracles of nature. To begin with, we will venture into Austria's Salzburg region. An area that is famous for its Alps and Tauern mountains but also because it is the birth place of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. After that, we will move over to the south western outpost of the old continent, to Portugal's Algarve region. To conclude, we will admire Corsica, the French island of beauty.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E06 - Naturally Miraculous
programme.desc: In the rain forests of the Seychelles we encounter remarkable fauna and flora. Then on to Mauritius. Where the symbol of the cruel and inconsiderate colonization of Africa is the extinct Dodo bird. We conclude today’s episode in the very heart of Africa, in the only place on the planet where close relatives to humans, the mountain gorillas - live. The country is the Democratic Republic of Congo and the province we shall visit is South Kivu.
